chunks: And through its chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
I have not seen anyone broader between the shoulders than the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family).
ai.seo_question: What physical characteristic of the Prophet did Ali (a.s.) highlight?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Prophet’s majestic physical presence, a trait often interpreted in Shia tradition as a manifestation of his inner nobility and divine favor. The specific mention of broad shoulders serves as a tangible sign of his strength and leadership, reinforcing the concept that the Prophet’s outward appearance reflected his spiritual stature.
